## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 1. Standard daily window filter (most common)
WHERE time_window = '1d'
  AND grass_region IN ('SG', 'MY', 'ID', 'PH', 'TH', 'VN', 'TW', 'BR')
  AND grass_date = date('${LOOKBACK_DATE}')

-- 2. Date range for replay window aggregation
WHERE time_window = '1d'
  AND grass_region IN ({REGIONS_SQL})
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date('${START_DATE}') AND date('${END_DATE}')

-- 3. Baseline coefficient only (for ecpm2 reference)
WHERE coef = 10000
  AND time_window = '1d'
  AND campaign_daily_budget_local > 0
  AND grass_date = date('${DATE}')

-- 4. Budget-valid entries only
WHERE campaign_valid_budget_local > 0
  AND grass_region IN ({REGIONS_SQL})

-- 5. Posterior window for historical predictions
WHERE time_window = '1d'
  AND grass_date BETWEEN date_sub(date('${START}'), 7) AND date_sub(date('${START}'), 1)
  AND grass_region IN ({REGIONS_SQL})
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- Pattern 1: JOIN with campaign_targets for campaign window (DOMINANT pattern, ~80% of use cases)
-- Purpose: Filter replay log data to active campaign periods
INNER JOIN campaign_window c
  ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
  AND r.grass_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date

-- Pattern 2: Self-join to compute ecpm2 increase factor (baseline coef=10000)
-- Purpose: Calculate how much each coefficient boosts eCPM relative to control
WITH base_coeff AS (
  SELECT campaign_id, grass_region, grass_date,
         SUM(ecpm2) AS ecpm2_base
  FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
  WHERE coef = 10000 AND time_window = '1d'
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT a.*, a.ecpm2 / CAST(b.ecpm2_base AS DOUBLE) AS ecpm2_increase_factor
FROM campaign_logs a
INNER JOIN base_coeff b
  ON a.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
  AND a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date

-- Pattern 3: Posterior predictions (historical lookback before campaign start)
-- Purpose: Enrich training data with pre-campaign performance signals
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date = date_sub(date('{START}'), 1) THEN porder ELSE 0 END) AS porder_1d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date >= date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) THEN porder ELSE 0 END) AS porder_7d,
  AVG(CASE WHEN grass_date >= date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) THEN porder END) AS porder_7d_avg
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new r
INNER JOIN campaign_window c
  ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
  AND r.grass_date BETWEEN date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) AND date_sub(date('{START}'), 1)
WHERE r.time_window = '1d'
GROUP BY c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, r.coef
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 1. Campaign-level replay metrics aggregation (most common pattern)
SELECT
  grass_region, campaign_id, coef,
  SUM(pv)       AS pv,         -- predicted impressions
  SUM(porder)   AS porder,     -- predicted orders
  SUM(pgmv)     AS pgmv,       -- predicted GMV
  SUM(ecpm2)    AS ecpm2       -- estimated revenue
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
WHERE time_window = '1d' AND grass_date = '${DATE}'
GROUP BY grass_region, campaign_id, coef

-- 2. Budget aggregation (use MAX, not SUM)
SELECT
  campaign_id, grass_region, coef,
  MAX(campaign_daily_budget_local)  AS campaign_daily_budget_local,
  MAX(campaign_valid_budget_local)  AS campaign_valid_budget_local,
  MAX(campaign_daily_budget_usd)    AS campaign_daily_budget_usd,
  MAX(campaign_valid_budget_usd)    AS campaign_valid_budget_usd
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
WHERE time_window = '1d' AND grass_date = '${DATE}'
GROUP BY campaign_id, grass_region, coef

-- 3. Campaign-level with meet-target check
SELECT
  c.campaign_id, c.grass_region, r.coef,
  SUM(r.porder) AS porder,
  CASE
    WHEN c.target_type LIKE '%order%' AND SUM(r.porder) >= c.target THEN TRUE
    WHEN c.target_type LIKE '%gmv%'   AND SUM(r.pgmv) >= c.target THEN TRUE
    ELSE FALSE
  END AS p_meet_target
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new r
INNER JOIN campaign_window c
  ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
  AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
  AND r.grass_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
WHERE r.time_window = '1d'
GROUP BY c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, c.target_type, c.target, r.coef
```

### Snippet 1: Standard campaign replay aggregation (from get_training_data.py)
```sql
replay_log AS (
    SELECT c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, r.coef,
        SUM(r.pv) AS pv, SUM(r.ecpm2) AS ecpm2,
        SUM(r.porder) AS porder, SUM(r.pgmv) AS pgmv,
        CASE
            WHEN c.target_type LIKE '%order%' AND SUM(r.porder) >= c.target THEN TRUE
            WHEN c.target_type LIKE '%gmv%'   AND SUM(r.pgmv) >= c.target THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS p_meet_target
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new r
    INNER JOIN campaign_window c
        ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
        AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
        AND r.grass_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
    WHERE r.grass_region IN ({REGIONS}) AND r.time_window = '1d'
    GROUP BY c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, c.target_type, c.target, r.coef
)
```

### Snippet 2: ecpm2 baseline and increase factor (from eval_order)
```sql
base_coeff AS (
    SELECT grass_region, grass_date, campaign_id, coef,
           SUM(ecpm2) AS ecpm2_base
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
    WHERE coef = 10000 AND time_window = '1d'
      AND grass_date = date('${DATE}')
      AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'PH', 'VN', 'TW', 'SG', 'MY', 'BR')
      AND campaign_daily_budget_local > 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT ...,
  r.ecpm2 / CAST(b.ecpm2_base AS DOUBLE) AS ecpm2_increase_factor,
  ROUND(r.ecpm2 / CAST(b.ecpm2_base AS DOUBLE), 8) * campaign_daily_budget_local AS budget
FROM campaign_logs r
INNER JOIN base_coeff b
  ON r.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
  AND r.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND r.grass_date = b.grass_date
```

### Snippet 3: Posterior historical predictions (from get_training_data.py)
```sql
SELECT c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, r.coef,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.grass_date = date_sub(date('{START}'), 1) THEN r.ecpm2 ELSE 0 END) AS ecpm2_1d,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.grass_date >= date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) THEN r.porder ELSE 0 END) AS porder_7d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN r.grass_date >= date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) THEN r.porder END) AS porder_7d_avg
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new r
INNER JOIN campaign_window c
    ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
    AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
    AND r.grass_date BETWEEN date_sub(date('{START}'), 7) AND date_sub(date('{START}'), 1)
WHERE r.grass_region IN ({REGIONS}) AND r.time_window = '1d'
GROUP BY c.grass_region, c.campaign_id, r.coef
```

### Snippet 4: Budget curve fitting data extraction (from train_new.py)
```sql
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, ads_id, campaign_id, coef,
    porder, pgmv, ecpm2, campaign_valid_budget_local,
    ROUND(ecpm2_increase_factor, 8) AS ecpm2_increase_factor,
    ROUND(ecpm2_increase_factor, 8) * campaign_daily_budget_local AS budget
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
WHERE time_window = '1d'
  AND grass_date >= date('${BIZ_TIME}') - interval 30 days
  AND grass_date <= date('${BIZ_TIME}') - interval 1 day
  AND grass_region IN ('BR')
  AND campaign_daily_budget_local > 0
```

### Snippet 5: Reward calibration data extraction (from reward_cali_data.py)
```sql
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.grass_region,
    SUM(r.porder) AS porder, SUM(r.pgmv) AS pgmv
FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new r
INNER JOIN campaign_window c
    ON r.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
    AND r.grass_region = c.grass_region
    AND r.grass_date BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.end_date
WHERE r.grass_region IN ({REGIONS})
  AND r.campaign_valid_budget_local > 0
  AND r.coef = 10000
GROUP BY c.grass_region, c.campaign_id
```

### Write Logic Summary

```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE ${SCHEMA}.dws_traffic_boost_training_data_new
PARTITION (grass_date = '${T-1}', grass_region)
SELECT
    ads_id, campaign_id, time_window, target_timestamp, coef,
    MAX(pv) AS pv,
    MAX(porder) AS porder,
    MAX(pgmv) AS pgmv,
    MAX(ecpm) AS ecpm2,
    MAX(ecpm / base_ecpm) AS ecpm2_increase_factor,
    MAX(b.campaign_daily_budget_local) AS campaign_daily_budget_local,
    MAX(b.campaign_daily_budget_usd) AS campaign_daily_budget_usd,
    MAX(b.campaign_valid_budget_local) AS campaign_valid_budget_local,
    MAX(b.campaign_valid_budget_usd) AS campaign_valid_budget_usd,
    grass_region
FROM tmp_replay_log_data a
LEFT JOIN tmp_daily_budget b
    ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
    AND a.grass_date = CAST(b.grass_date AS DATE)
    AND a.ads_id = b.ads_id
GROUP BY grass_region, ads_id, campaign_id, time_window, target_timestamp, coef
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下指标在 2+ 个文件中被反复计算，可用于直接引用：

| Metric | Formula | Usage |
|--------|---------|-------|
| `budget` | `ecpm2_increase_factor * campaign_daily_budget_local` | Effective daily budget adjusted by bid coefficient |
| `p_meet_target` | `CASE WHEN SUM(porder) >= target THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END` | Whether predicted orders/GMV meet the campaign target |
| `ecpm2_1d/3d/7d` | `SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date in window THEN ecpm2 ELSE 0 END)` | Windowed posterior eCPM before campaign start |
| `porder_1d/3d/7d` | `SUM(CASE WHEN grass_date in window THEN porder ELSE 0 END)` | Windowed posterior orders before campaign start |
